### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A02, A03, and A08 are no longer observed at all; in the earlier window they appeared in about 47% (A02, A08) and 21% (A03) of traces, with mean occurrences per trace of 0.84, 0.37, and 0.84 respectively. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, POS002, POS003, POS005, DIR002, DIR003, DIR005, DIR006, DIR010]
- Participation of A07 dropped from about 47% to 17% of traces, and A14 from 47% to about 31%. [OCC003, OCC005, POS004, POS006]
- The successor of A01 changed: in the earlier window it went to A06 (44%), A07 (31%), A14 (25%); in the later window it goes exclusively to A11. [DIR001]
- The successor of A10 changed from A08 to A01. [DIR008]
- The successor of A16 changed from A01 to A06/A07/A14. [DIR011]
- The successors of A05, A09, A17, A18, A13, and A19 also shifted, e.g., A05 now goes to A10 instead of A02, A09 now goes to A17 instead of A18/A05, A18 now goes to A10 instead of A02, etc. [DIR004, DIR007, DIR009, DIR012, DIR013, DIR014]
- Co-occurrence patterns: A02 no longer co-occurs with any activity; A01 and A16 now co-occur with A10, A11, etc., whereas before they co-occurred with A02, A08, etc. [REL001, REL005, REL012, REL013, REL016, REL041, REL042, REL045]
- Relative positions (lags) between many activity pairs shifted, e.g., A01 and A07 now have a lag of 3 instead of 1–2, A16 and A01 now have a lag of 5 instead of 1, etc. [LAG003, LAG005, LAG022, LAG033, LAG036, LAG038]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the process changed from having a branch that included activities A02, A03, and A08 (and often A07, A14) to a branch that instead uses A10, A11, and related activities. In the earlier window, about 47% of traces contained A02, A08, and A07, and A03 in about 21%; in the later window, A02, A03, and A08 are absent, and A07 and A14 are much less frequent. The successor of A01 changed from A06/A07/A14 to A11, and A10 now leads to A01 instead of A08, indicating a re-routing of the main flow. This is supported by the disappearance of A02/A03/A08 in OCC, POS, and DIR, and by the co-occurrence and lag changes.

Other differences: A07 and A14 still occur but less often; A05, A09, A10, A11, A17, A18, and A19 appear or increase in the later window. These are consistent with the replacement of the old branch.

Limitation: The evidence does not show why the change happened, and we cannot rule out that the later window is a different process variant rather than a change over time, but the consistency across many indicators supports a structural change.
